# services/agent — Lean Context (see llms-full.txt for implementation details)

Fastify + Prisma service for AI agent session management. Port 3003.

## Key Types

type SessionStatus = "PENDING" | "RUNNING" | "SUCCEEDED" | "FAILED" | "CANCELLED"

## Services

### storedSpecService (src/services/stored-spec.ts)
- list(userId): StoredSpec[]
- getById(id): StoredSpec | null
- create(data: { userId, prompt, spec, rawLines }): StoredSpec
- toggleFavorite(id, userId): StoredSpec
- delete(id, userId): void

interface StoredSpecResponse { id, userId, prompt, spec, rawLines, isFavorite, createdAt, updatedAt }
function mapStoredSpec(s: StoredSpec): StoredSpecResponse

### sessionService (src/services/session.ts)
- list(options: ListOptions): { data: AgentSession[], pagination: Pagination }
- getById(id): AgentSession | null
- create(data: { taskDescription, model?, maxTurns?, maxBudgetUsd?, baseBranch?, createPr?, parentId? }): AgentSession
- updateStatus(id, status, result?): AgentSession | null
- delete(id): boolean
- addEvent(sessionId, type, data?): AgentSessionEvent
- listEvents(sessionId, afterId?): AgentSessionEvent[]

### session-executor (src/services/session-executor.ts)
- getActiveSessionCount(): number
- executeSession(session: AgentSession): void
- cancelSession(sessionId): boolean

### circuit breaker (src/services/remediation-circuit-breaker.ts)
- checkCircuitBreaker(): CircuitCheckResult { allowed, reason? }
- recordRemediationOutcome(succeeded): void

### database (src/services/database.ts)
- prisma: PrismaClient
- getSlowQueryStats(): { count5min, slowestMs }
- getServiceStatus(): "ok" | "degraded"

## Schemas (src/schemas/index.ts)

SessionStatusEnum, SessionSchema, SessionEventSchema, CreateSessionBodySchema, PaginationSchema, ErrorSchema
function registerSchemas(fastify): void

## Routes

### Sessions: src/routes/sessions.ts
POST /v1/sessions, GET /v1/sessions, GET /v1/sessions/:id, DELETE /v1/sessions/:id

### Session Events: src/routes/session-events.ts
GET /v1/sessions/:id/events (SSE)

### Orchestrate: src/routes/orchestrate.ts
POST /v1/orchestrate — decomposes task into parallel child sessions
interface OrchestrateBody { taskDescription, model?, sessionModel?, maxBudgetPerSession?, maxTurnsPerSession?, baseBranch?, maxConcurrentSessions? }
interface OrchestrateResponse { parentSessionId, status, childSessionIds, summary, totalCostUsd, durationMs }

### Webhooks: src/routes/webhooks.ts
POST /v1/webhooks/github — handles issue, issue_comment, check_run events
interface GitHubIssueEvent { action, label?, issue, repository }
interface GitHubIssueCommentEvent { action, comment, issue, repository }
interface GitHubCheckRunEvent { action, check_run, repository }

### Remediation: src/routes/remediation.ts
Handles alert-triggered auto-remediation

### Gen UI: src/routes/gen-ui.ts
POST /api/gen/ui — streaming UI generation (JSONL)

### Gen Chat: src/routes/gen-chat.ts
POST /api/gen/chat — streaming chat (SSE)

### Gen Specs: src/routes/gen-specs.ts
POST /api/gen/specs — streaming spec generation (SSE)

### Health: src/routes/health.ts
GET /health

## App Entry

src/app.ts: buildApp(options?: AppOptions): FastifyInstance
src/index.ts: main() — starts server
